GEO600 in 2013: One year of squeezing

In 2013, the GEO team published a paper showing that squeezed light – back then a relatively new technology – can be permanently used in gravitational-wave detectors.

Over a period of almost one year, squeezing was applied for 90% of the GEO600 science time, and a total of 205 days!

More info at https://www.geo600.org/25645/2013

You can read up on the nitty-gritty science in https://arxiv.org/abs/1302.2188.
